title: Corpulent

inlines.v: CORPULENT, adjective Fleshy; having a great or excessive quantity of fat or flesh, in proportion to the frame of the body; as a corpulent child. Corpus Christi. [Body of Christ.] A festival of the church of England, kept on the next Thursday after Trinity-Sunday, in honor of the Eucharist.
